summary: Gold Fields reported H1 2026 results, declaring an interim dividend of 1,625 SA cents per share (up from 700 cents) and increasing its shareholder returns program. The company completed $300 million in buybacks between March and July 2026 and allocated an additional $500 million, lifting the total additional returns program to $1.25 billion, to be delivered via special dividends and targeted buybacks. This reflects a stepped-up capital return policy, with 61% of adjusted free cash flow paid to shareholders. Watch for execution of buybacks and special dividends, and potential impact on share price support.
